hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';process.stdout.write(f);}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.tsx|*.jsx|*.md) npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; case "$f" in *.tsx|*.jsx) out=$(npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1); if [ -n "$out" ]; then node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({systemMessage: process.argv[1]}))" "$out"; fi ;; esac ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
